items.title: Live: Trump says war in Iran will be over 'when I feel it in my bones', Iran leader 'damaged'
items.description: A large explosion rocks Iran's capital, where thousands had gathered for a rally to support Palestinians, while the US military confirms all six crew members who were onboard a refuelling aircraft that crashed in western Iraq have died. Follow live.

items.title: Iran is increasingly controlling the direction of this war
items.description: If there ever was a strategy behind Donald Trump's decision to blow up the Middle East, it is lying in tatters as the second week of the Iran war draws to a close.

items.title: 'What about us?' Iranians waiting years to receive asylum in Australia
items.description: Iranian refugees in Australia welcome Iran's footballers being granted asylum, but question why others remain stuck on a years' long waitlist for permanent residency.

items.title: He risked his life at Bondi. But this Iranian refugee failed our character test
items.description: AB ran into danger during Bondi's terrorist attacks to save lives. Four months on, he faces deportation after failing Australia's refugee character test. His family is urging the Albanese government to reconsider.

items.title: Former spy chief says Bondi intelligence findings 'cannot wait'
items.description: Dennis Richardson calls for a second interim report from the royal commission into antisemitism, warning it would be "unacceptable" to leave findings about any intelligence failures that contributed to the Bondi terrorist attack until the end of the year.

items.title: Fresh twist in case of child molester and former international fugitive
items.description: There been a fresh twist in the long-running saga of child molester Charles Batham, with NSW authorities requesting his transfer from jail interstate to face new charges.

items.title: Second round of flooding for inland Australia after a year's rain in 72 hours
items.description: Another burst of tropical moisture and heavy rain will descend through the heart of Australia during the coming days.

items.title: Chalmers and his boffins face some tough budget decisions due to Iran
items.description: The war against Iran threatens to have a destabilising impact on this year's federal budget.

items.title: Why experts are worried about the latest peptides trend
items.description: The latest wellness craze to take social media by storm is fuelling a growing grey market of injectable peptides in Australia, and it has experts worried.

items.title: First known image of Mountbatten-Windsor, Mandelson and Epstein released
items.description: An image appearing to show Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor and the sacked UK ambassador to Washington, Peter Mandelson, with convicted paedophile Jeffrey Epstein has been uncovered in the latest document dump released by the US DOJ.

items.title: China unveils its plan to dominate the future of technology and AI
items.description: China unveils its five-year plan for tech dominance — including flying cars, brain-chip implants and humanoid robots.

items.title: Imperfect Matildas get perfect result to make Asian Cup semis
items.description: Despite being largely outplayed by North Korea, the Australians have activated their belief mindset, and are zeroing in on the Women's Asian Cup trophy.

items.title: Mary and Fred's love story: How a girl from Hobart met a prince and became queen
items.description: As Denmark's royal couple, King Frederik and Australian-born Queen Mary, tour the queen's homeland, we look back at how their romance began.

items.title: Inside story of the human impact of a government email scandal
items.description: Bronwen Paterson spoke out about the devastation of her partner experiencing ramping in his final hours. Then, a government email bungle left her traumatised.

items.title: Here's why Melburnians never fell for Kyle and Jackie O
items.description: You could argue Melbourne didn't warm to the the duo's shock jock style but I think the answer is much simpler.

items.title: A critic and a mathematician pick their 2026 Oscar winners
items.description: Who is better at predicting this year's Oscar winners — a mathematician or a critic?

items.title: ABC 50/50 quiz: Test your knowledge of 70s rock, Pixar and our national anthem
items.description: Every question has only two options: one is right and the other is wrong. You have an even chance of guessing correctly each time.

items.title: 'Bit of a dodgy move': Bluesfest ticketholders question cancellation timing
items.description: Festival revellers, who have spent thousands on the event, are angry and have been left wondering when organisers knew it was not viable.

items.title: What does Katy Perry's loss in the High Court mean for her business?
items.description: Australian fashion designer Katie Perry has won her long-running trademark battle against pop star Katy Perry, but questions about whether the singer will be able to sell her clothing merchandise as part of any future tours remain.

items.title: Media figure Antony Catalano charged with assault
items.description: The co-owner of national newspaper company ACM appears in court, with police alleging he assaulted a woman and swung a clothes iron at her head.

items.title: What kind of exercise is most effective at reducing period pain?
items.description: Period pain can be crippling, but could exercise help relieve it? A reproductive health expert explains.

items.title: Tudhope claims second medal of Paralympics with para-snowboard bronze
items.description: Ben Tudhope has won his second medal of the Milano Cortina 2026 Paralympic Games, claiming bronze in the men's banked slalom SB-LL2.

items.title: Alex Johnston's record-breaking try was a moment of pure humanity
items.description: After all the speculation, the fans stormed the field in the aftermath of Alex Johnston's record-breaking try and the result was an outpouring of emotion celebrating a once-in-a-lifetime achievement.

items.title: Migrant language course failing to teach English skills, educators say
items.description: A migrant centre in Melbourne says people are coming to its classes after the federally-funded Adult Migrant English Program left them unable to hold day-to-day conversations.

items.title: Piastri pleased in China, but 'impressive' Mercedes continue F1 dominance
items.description: Mercedes has once again dominated the Formula 1 field, qualifying their cars first and second for Saturday's sprint race in China.
